title: Dawn on Mars: Curiosity Rover Frames Ancient Cliffs in Rare Morning Light
description: NASA's Curiosity rover captured a striking panorama of Martian dawn illuminating wind-carved yardangs on Mount Sharp. The image, taken without white balancing, reveals an anomalous rock layer that puzzles scientists and offers new clues about the planet's geologic past. The scene highlights both the beauty and scientific richness of ongoing Mars exploration.

title: Was the human gut healthier in ancient times?
description: The human microbiome – the trillions of microbes that live in our guts – was a stable ecosystem for tens of thousands of years before rapidly changing in industrialized countries, raising possible health concerns for modern people, scientists reported on Wednesday.

title: Ancient Persian and Linguistic History: A Discussion
description: Kevin van Bladel’s new book Ancient Persian: A Linguistic History (Cambridge University Press 2026, Open Access) claims that the creation of the first Persian empire triggered demographic changes that caused the grammar of the Persian language to be transformed. This panel discussion will begin with the author’s presentation of the book in brief followed by reflections of other scholars on it and its ramifications.
